sentences.text: This petition was called on for hearing today.
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SURYA KANT

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE UJJAL BHUYAN  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Karan Kapoor, Adv.
 Mr. Manik Kapoor, Adv.
 Ms. Srishti Singla, Adv.
 Mr. Shrey Kapoor, AOR  For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

2. Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner at a considerable length and on perusal of the entire record, we are satisfied that no case of declaring the acquisition to have lapsed under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, is made out.
